description: Gives an active agency staff member access to one client business with the admin or member business role. Requires an agency owner or admin who can manage that client; only the owner can assign an admin staff member. Assigning an existing assignment again changes nothing.

businessId.description: The client business to grant access to.

businessRole.description: Business role to grant: admin or member.

userId.description: The agency staff member to assign.

name: agency_profile_assign
title: Assign Staff Member to Client
